lxc_8d6d1cd1a710661e.text: One Bishop of Norwich often fell asleep at dinner, so the port stopped next to him.

lxc_1f7aafe6d520af8e.text: You cut a small Charentais melon in half, take out the seeds and pour Pineau into the middle.

lxc_aedf3376ae50c176.text: A summer favourite is melon au Pineau.

lxc_d42283701942f79d.text: In Britain, port is often served at the end of a formal dinner.

lxc_78743a33c7a90cff.text: A bishop is a church leader, and Norwich is a city in England.

lxc_c8f290f777ff5342.text: The wine must stay cold, so people usually order half bottles, not full ones.

lxc_46f8d02d1d2abdde.text: People drink each of these wines at the time and the temperature that are best for its taste.

lxc_0c52fc395950b18d.text: The melon is named after the same region, and its sweet fruit matches the sweet grape taste of the drink.

lxc_a45e51f3e29524bf.text: A half bottle gives about six glasses, so it is empty before it gets warm.

lxc_4fb98388e38ac5c2.text: The bottle is passed to the left, so it goes around the table in one direction and reaches everyone.

lxc_89040a860305ed77.text: In southern Spain, fino and manzanilla are dry and fresh, and they taste best very cold.

lxc_1b881aacbe0df263.text: In the Charente, Pineau is an aperitif, a drink before the meal.

lxc_798829b3214e035d.text: The question is a polite way to say: please pass the bottle.

lxc_e65e56d2104d4a55.text: With Madeira, dry styles are drunk before a meal.

lxc_2af2261fcb698aab.text: These wines are the stars of the spring fairs, such as the famous one in Seville.

lxc_68c0bf99be7d4ab2.text: Its fresh grape taste is best when it is cold, so people serve it at about 8 to 10 degrees.

lxc_f4fc8e8789233043.text: Its sweet, strong taste is a good way to end the meal.

lxc_f5fea436f44f4ddd.text: People keep the bottle in a bucket of ice and water.

lxc_f8bd8191225f95d6.text: Each place has one custom that shows this well.

lxc_fa74cdde0b580c35.text: They do not add ice, because the ice would melt and make the drink weaker.

lxc_490aef5cbf63da0f.text: So even the last glass is still cold.
